description.value: Sandman Inn Smithers is a chain hotel on Highway 16 West serving the Yellowhead Highway corridor through Smithers. It has earned Bronze Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting an active sustainability program including a GreenStep EcoFund contribution per guest night. An on-site Tim Hortons operates 24 hours, and the property includes a fitness centre and business centre.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and confirms an active, bookable hotel with amenities listed on a dedicated amenities page. OSM tags and website agree on Wi-Fi (OSM: internet_access=wlan; website: 'Free Wi-Fi'). Room detail subpage confirms USB Charging Ports. A Tim Hortons 24-Hour Restaurant is listed as a dining option in the room description, confirming on-site food. No bike-specific amenities (storage, wash, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website. The OSM combined address contains a duplication ('3932 3932 Highway 16 W') because addr:housenumber and addr:street both carry the number; the corrected address is used and the error flagged.
concerns: OSM address duplication: addr:housenumber (3932) is also embedded in addr:street ('3932 Highway 16 W'), producing '3932 3932 Highway 16 W' in the combined field. Corrected to '3932 Highway 16 W' in this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel on a major touring route. Website confirms open status with live room rates.

Nearby evening food.detail: Tim Hortons 24-Hour Restaurant listed as an on-site dining option in room descriptions
